44089056_515a5cbe.text: The locus coeruleus (LC) is the largest source of forebrain norepinephrine (NE), and abnormalities in LC-NE function contribute to diseases such as anxiety, depression, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and attention deficit hyperactive disorder (ADHD)

44089056_12397071.text: .In the mouse, the LC is comprised of approximately 2,000 neurons per side, the majority of which are uniquely noradrenergic (Robertson et al., 2013; Chandler et al., 2014)

44089056_2fece573.text: .We profiled mouse noradrenergic neurons in vivo, defining over 3,000 high-confidence transcripts expressed therein, including druggable receptors

44089056_039ea99e.text: .To compare molecular differences in female and male LC neurons, we developed a translational profiling strategy by combining the bacTRAP technology with a tyrosine hydroxylase driver line, generating Th-EGFP-L10a transgenic mice

44089056_b244fe2c.text: .we observed GFP-positive cells in catecholaminergic populations throughout the brain and retina, including in the LC, ventral tegmental area (VTA), substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc), hypothalamic arcuate nucleus, and olfactory bulb, among others, and in retinal amacrine and ganglion cells

44089056_ebe9fa62.text: .We additionally stained transgenic LC sections for DBH, and we observed 100% co-expression of the EGFP-L10a transgene in TH- positive, DBH-positive LC neurons (Figure 1A)

44089056_3ab473f9.text: .We then used this line to molecularly profile female and male LC neurons under baseline conditions

44089056_840006f4.text: .We generated four biological replicates each of female and male adult LC neuron input and immunoprecipitation (IP) samples

44089056_818197f4.text: .In total, we identified 3,045 genes significantly enriched in LC neurons, and these represent a molecular profile of LC neurons in the mouse

44089056_03c032a1.text: .We note that genes required for NE synthesis and release, including Gch1, Slc6a2, Slc18a2, Dbh, and Th, are highly enriched in the LC translatome, and therefore constitute useful markers for this neuronal population.
